items.name: TownSquare / TOWN

platform_token.raw: 交接包：TOWN 有治理规则（待附原文）

versions.why_zh: 产品估值、发行方储备证明、借贷 TVL、TOWN 治理规则是四类不同证据；一笔链上证明交易不能验证线下资产和个人可参与性。
versions.why_en: Product valuation, issuer reserve attestations, lending TVL and TOWN governance are four different kinds of evidence; one onchain proof tx does not verify offchain assets or personal eligibility.
